title: US Leveraged Loans Lose the Most Since 2022 on AI-Driven Fears

title: Stocks Lower on Block, Credit Jitters | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 2/27/2025
content: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss today's hotter-than-expected PPI print and stock reaction, with the S&P 500 on track for its worst month since March. Bloomberg's Enda Curran joins to discuss. Then, Compass CEO Robert Riffkin and Rocket Companies CEO Varun Krishna join to discuss their new partnership aimed at expanding home listing inventory on Redfin. Then, Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry on recent earnings and the potential AI impact on his business. Finally, Duolingo CEO Luis von Ahn on the language-learning app's plans to double daily active users to 100 million by 2028. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Private Credit Cracks Worry Investors | Open Interest 2/27/2026
content:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Matt Miller and Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." OpenAI shatters fundraising records. The ChatGPT maker closes a staggering $110 billion round, backed by Amazon, SoftBank, and Nvidia.  Jack Dorsey swings the ax at Block. And MFS’s blowup sends fresh tremors through the financial sector as new cracks emerge in private credit. Monroe Capital Chairman and CEO Ted Koenig joins us. His firm manages $23.6 billion in assets.
Plus Paramount shares surge on reports it could spend $111 billion for Warner Bros. We’ll speak with Okapi Partners CEO Bruce Goldfarb — his firm advises Paramount. (Source: Bloomberg)
